purpose: Historically matched candidate logos for review before integrating into team-logos-year.json
semantics: exact means file/page evidence supports that season; representative means suitable team-era fallback with no verified design validity; unknown means no season assignment; icon-only means low-resolution fallback and not an authentic full-size team logo. brand-only identifies a manufacturer or corporate mark and must retain a brand caption.
